passages.text: Influencer Collaborations Influencer collaborations are a cornerstone of Poppi’s marketing strategy. By partnering with key lifestyle and health influencers, the brand amplifies its reach and credibility. These influencers share authentic experiences with Poppi products on platforms like Instagram and TikTok, which drives consumer interest and engagement. Poppi selects influencers who resonate with their target demographic. This targeted approach ensures that the campaigns align with the lifestyle aspirations of potential customers. The use of Instagram stories allows influencers to showcase Poppi products in real-time, enhancing relatability and fostering a sense of community.

passages.text: The founders regularly documented the brand’s journey across TikTok and Instagram, giving consumers a behind the scenes look at product launches, retail wins, marketing campaigns, and the realities of scaling a fast-growing FMCG business. The next major chapter came when poppi was acquired by PepsiCo for $2 Billion, cementing its status as one of the most influential brands in modern soft drink marketing. From a homemade apple cider vinegar drink to an internationally recognised brand backed by one of the world’s largest FMCG brands globally.

passages.text: Exclusive Brand Collaborations Instead of sticking to traditional sponsorships, poppi partners with names that already live in the same cultural universe as its audience, helping it show up in places that feel exciting, unexpected and highly shareable. Whether it’s teaming up with Love Island, collaborating with travel favourite BÉIS, or joining forces with skincare brand Bubble, poppi consistently finds ways to place itself at the centre of conversations its audience already cares about. These partnerships aren’t just about putting logos side by side; they’re about creating moments that feel naturally aligned with the lifestyles, interests and online habits of poppi fans.
